objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the noSQL injection weakness of a Flask and MongoDB application with a GraphQL API that lists users but hides the admin user and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: Look at how the API passes your filter to the database: as a value, or as a query structure.
Explore the GraphQL schema to see every query and argument available.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which injection class applies to the document database query behind the API?

steps.title: Name the second weakness
steps.prompt: Which API query language does the application expose?
